{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I am baffled by critics who accept Mitth'raw'nuruodo's account of his discussion with Palpatine about the Far Outsiders, yet refuse to revise their opinions about either man. They ignore what Mitth'raw'nuruodo reported Palpatine believed: that the weak Republic would be defeated by the Vong, and had to be reforged into an orderly, militarized society able to resist them. They refuse to consider the possibility that the Empire's apparent brutality and ruthlessness were necessary parts of preparing for that terrible war. Why do they refuse to do so? Because that would lead them to the only logical conclusion: that Palpatine was right.|Lenang O'Pali|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Lenang O'Pali''' was a polemicist and fierce partisan for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], long after it had fallen. O'Pali wrote the publication ''[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective]]'' in [[55 ABY]]. O'Pali's piece was an account of the role played in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], better known as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn. O'Pali took a revisionist position and believed Thrawn and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to be heroes, who had been devoted to preparing the galaxy to face the threat of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. O'Pali also attacked the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as having left the galaxy defenseless before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] by overthrowing the Galactic Empire.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Recent galactic history is not the struggle for freedom our children are force-fed &mdash; or should I style it Force-fed &mdash; on HoloNet channels controlled by Mothmatist news agencies. Rather, it is a succession of unlucky events that left our civilization defenseless against the Vong.|An example of O'Pali's writing style|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />}}
A strong supporter of the Galactic Empire even [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] after its fall, O'Pali considered Thrawn and Emperor Palpatine to be great men for trying to prepare the galaxy for the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], and further believed that this exonerated the Empire for many of its atrocities and ruthless suppression of dissent: O'Pali considered these necessary parts of preparing the galaxy for the invasion. Consequently, O'Pali considered the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and the establishment of the New Republic to be terrible mistakes that let down the galaxy's defenses.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

O'Pali had a polemical writing style, and attacked critics and supporters of the New Republic as "[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mothmatists]]," and alleged that they controlled [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news channels in collusion with the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lenang O'Pali was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />
